# DYC Projects

> DYC Projects is a Sydney-based technology consultancy that designs, builds, migrates and runs secure, scalable cloud and software systems for Australian businesses.

Contact: 0451 836 661 · info@dycprojects.com.au
Location: Ryde NSW, Australia

## Pages
- [DYC Projects](https://dycprojects.com.au/): DYC Projects designs, builds, migrates and runs secure, scalable cloud and software systems for Australian businesses. Plain-spoken advice, reliable delivery. Book a free consultation.
- [Services](https://dycprojects.com.au/services/): Cloud architecture and migration, custom software development, DevOps and automation, managed cloud, cloud security and technical consulting for Australian businesses.
- [Cloud Architecture & Migration (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)](https://dycprojects.com.au/services/cloud-architecture-migration/): Plan and execute secure, cost-effective moves to Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, including hybrid setups. Assessment, architecture, migration and ongoing optimisation.
- [Custom Software Development](https://dycprojects.com.au/services/custom-software-development/): Web applications, internal business tools, APIs and system integrations built around the way your business works. Sydney-based, delivering across Australia.
- [DevOps & Automation](https://dycprojects.com.au/services/devops-automation/): CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containerisation and automated deployments that speed up delivery and reduce errors.
- [Contact](https://dycprojects.com.au/contact/): Book a free consultation with DYC Projects to talk through your cloud, software or DevOps needs. Call 0451 836 661 or email info@dycprojects.com.au.
